record.prompt: Please rebuild the price page with site/build.js and tell me how many products it lists and which listed product is the cheapest. Don't modify build.js.
record.final_answer:
I rebuilt the page by running `node build.js` from inside `site/`. That folder matters because the script uses relative paths and would fail from the repo root. It finished without errors and wrote `site/public/prices.html`.

**The page lists 6 products.** It only includes products marked active in `data/products.json`, which has 10 in total.

| Product | Price |
|---|---|
| Anchor mug | 14.50 |
| Bramble journal | 8.90 |
| Dune tote bag | 24.00 |
| **Fable pencil set** | **7.60** |
| Gale scarf | 31.50 |
| Ivy plant pot | 13.20 |

**The cheapest listed product is the Fable pencil set at 7.60.** Juniper soap (5.90) and Ember tea tin (7.20) are cheaper, but they're inactive, so they don't appear on the page.

I didn't change `build.js`.
